Excelsior and FC Volendam faced off on May 10, 2026 , in an Eredivisie clash that delivered drama from the opening whistle. In front of a crowd of 4,600, both sides looked to make a statement in a match characterized by contrasting styles and tactical shifts. Early Fireworks and a Costly Mistake The match ignited almost immediately as FC Volendam stunned the home supporters in the 2nd minute. Benjamin Pauwels found space outside the box and, after receiving a pass from Juninho Bacuna , unleashed a precise right-footed strike that flew past the goalkeeper into the net. This early goal forced Excelsior to chase the game, and they responded with waves of pressure. Derensili Sanches Fernandes was central to their efforts, delivering several corners as the hosts searched for an equalizer. The persistence of the home side finally paid off in the 38th minute, albeit through a stroke of misfortune for the visitors. During a dangerous Excelsior attack, Gibson Yah inadvertently directed the ball into his own net while trying to clear the danger. The own goal brought the scores level just before the interval, erasing Volendam's lead and setting the stage for a tense second half. Dominance Without a Decisive Blow The second half saw Excelsior exert significant control over the match, maintaining a dominant 67% of ball possession. Despite their superior ball retention, clear-cut chances were hard to come by as FC Volendam sat deep and defended resolutely. Tactical changes were made by both managers, with Brandley Kuwas and Szymon Wlodarczyk coming on for the hosts, while Henk Veerman was introduced for the visitors. The physical nature of the contest intensified, leading to yellow cards for Nick Verschuren , Adam Carlen , and Alex Plat . In the closing stages, Brandley Kuwas had a chance to snatch a winner with a direct free kick in the 76th minute, but his effort sailed wide of the post. Despite a late flurry of activity in the opponent's half and three minutes of added time, neither side could find the decisive breakthrough. The match ended in a draw, leaving both teams with a point after a battle that saw Excelsior's possession met with Volendam's disciplined defensive display.

The tension was palpable as FC Volendam hosted SC Heerenveen in an Eredivisie clash on 2026-05-03 . Both sides were determined to seize control of the midfield in a match that kept the 6,948 fans in attendance on the edge of their seats until the final whistle. Oyen Sets the Early Tempo The contest began with high intensity as SC Heerenveen looked to unsettle the hosts from the opening whistle. Their persistence was rewarded in just the 8th minute when Vasilios Zagaritis delivered a pinpoint cross into the heart of the box. Luca Oyen rose highest to meet the delivery, steering a powerful header home to give the visitors an early advantage. The goal forced FC Volendam to rethink their strategy, but their frustration manifested in early bookings for Precious Ugwu and Juninho Bacuna , both of whom received yellow cards for dangerous challenges within the first quarter-hour as they struggled to contain the Heerenveen momentum. Volendam Pressure and Tactical Shifts Despite the early setback, FC Volendam carved out a significant chance to level the score during the first half . Henk Veerman came closest in the 14th minute, directing a header toward the target that required a sharp, comfortable save from Bernt Klaverboer . As the game progressed, Bilal Ould-Chikh and Juninho Bacuna looked to utilize set pieces to break down the Heerenveen defense, but a series of corners failed to find a clinical finishing touch. The physical nature of the match continued into the later stages of the half, with Nordin Bukala and Joris van Overeem both entering the referee's book as the battle for supremacy intensified. Substitutions and Mounting Tension The second half saw the FC Volendam coaching staff search for an equalizer through a flurry of tactical substitutions. Gibson Yah , Brandley Kuwas , and the experienced Robert Muehren were introduced shortly after the break to inject fresh energy into the attack. Muehren nearly made an immediate impact in the 75th minute with a well-placed header, but Bernt Klaverboer remained resolute in the Heerenveen goal. The home side continued to push, but they were often caught in the transition, as the visitors utilized their defensive structure to frustrate the Volendam forwards and maintain their slim lead. Clinical Finishing Seals the Result The hosts’ inability to convert their pressure proved costly in the 86th minute when Jacob Trenskow turned provider, setting up Dylan Vente for a decisive moment. Vente made no mistake, firing a right-footed shot into the net to double the lead and effectively silence the home crowd. As the match entered seven minutes of stoppage time, SC Heerenveen focused on preserving their advantage and managing the clock. Lasse Nordaas received a late yellow card for a robust challenge, reflecting the competitive spirit that lasted until the very end. FC Volendam launched a final assault, with Yannick Leliendal and Brandley Kuwas testing the defense, but the Heerenveen backline held firm to confirm a disciplined away performance.
